title: WP-2026-0149: git-clean keeps a branch whose work landed inside a larger squash
problem:
## Problem

`badf_gate.py git-clean` (WP-2026-0147) deletes a local branch only when it is MERGED (an ancestor) or SQUASHED (its net-diff patch-id matches a commit on `main`). A branch whose change landed *inside a larger squash* matches neither, so it is kept as UNMERGED even though its work is on `main`. A cherry-pick into a work-package PR is exactly this case.

Observed on `bst/adoring-bell-l8y5oy`. Its one commit (the WP-2026-0147 reconcile) was cherry-picked into #342 alongside other files. `work/WP-2026-0147/work-package.json` is byte-identical on `main`. Its other file, `badf/lockfile.json`, was re-signed again on `main`. git-clean kept the branch, and it had to be removed by hand.

## Requested outcome

Add a `CONTENT_LANDED` class to git-clean: every path the branch changed since its merge base is byte-identical on `origin/main`.

- Content and mode must match, and deletions are included.
- `badf/lockfile.json` is left out of the comparison. `badf_gate.py lock` regenerates it from every other governed file, so a superseded copy carries nothing unique.
- A branch that changed only the lockfile is never landed.
- A path that `main` changed again afterwards keeps the branch UNMERGED.
- The dry run still writes nothing, and `--apply` still preserves each tip before a guarded delete.

This work package also carries the WP-2026-0148 reconcile.

Authorised by the operator in a Claude Code session on 2026-09-28.
